training: Equal counts from each replica, uniformly sampled across each available interval
scaling: Training-set mean and standard deviation; constant features excluded
assignment: K-means/Ward: nearest centroid. DBSCAN: fit balanced training subset and assign all frames to nearest core within epsilon; otherwise cluster 0 (noise). This is a subsample density model, not a full-frame DBSCAN fit.
selection: Largest coverage times nonnegative silhouette proposes a model among candidates with at least five training frames per cluster. Smaller clusters remain in the candidate table for review; this technical screening is not a physical population cutoff. DBSCAN noise excluded from silhouette but penalized through coverage. Heuristic favors separation and may miss nonconvex states; inspect parameter sensitivity, representative structures and replica consistency before choosing physical states.
representative: Observed frame minimizing sum of squared Euclidean feature distances within each cluster; extracted unfitted coordinates. PDB uses topology residue numbering; see project residue mapping.
populations: Per-replica saved-frame fractions; no independent-frame error bars or thermodynamic claims
physical_labels: Neutral cluster IDs until structural inspection; no automatic closed/intermediate/open labels
